=== lib/user/user_repository.dart
class User {
  const User(this.name);

  final String name;
}

class UserRepository {
  Future<User> fetch(String id) async => User(id);
}
=== lib/user/cubit/user_cubit.dart
import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';

import '../user_repository.dart';

class UserCubit extends Cubit<User?> {
  UserCubit(this._repository) : super(null);

  final UserRepository _repository;

  Future<void> load(String id) async {
    final user = await _repository.fetch(id);
    emit(user);
  }
}
=== lib/user/view/user_page.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../cubit/user_cubit.dart';
import '../user_repository.dart';

class UserPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const UserPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (_) => UserCubit(context.read<UserRepository>())..load('1'),
      child: const UserView(),
    );
  }
}

class UserView extends StatelessWidget {
  const UserView({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final name = context.select((UserCubit cubit) => cubit.state?.name);
    return Text(name ?? '');
  }
}
